claims.quote: Receiving-source authenticity must be checked against a known supplier contact or original controlled receiving system. Record who verified it, the source reference, and the verification date. An exact quote or document hash does not authenticate a supplier.

passages.quote: Receiving-source authenticity must be checked against a known supplier contact or original controlled receiving system. Record who verified it, the source reference, and the verification date. An exact quote or document hash does not authenticate a supplier.

Before considering recovery, verify receiving-source authenticity, review complete lot ancestry, and record a passed visual inspection for the exact held pool. A proposed scope change alone is insufficient.

A complete receiving replacement records the stock pool, every confirmed supplier parent, all superseded lineage row identifiers, and the supporting source passage. Unresolved contradictions retain the restriction.

The visual inspection record identifies the stock pool, inspected and nonconforming unit counts, method, date, inspector and original source. Record the pass or fail against the owner-approved inspection criteria; statistical control limits are not product acceptance specifications.
